input.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Client is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink hereunder
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Client, which is the preferred position. Section 2(a) grants only a non-exclusive licence and expressly confirms Client is not obligated to use the Interface and remains free to acquire, develop or licence competing software and services (subject only to TrueLink's IP and confidentiality rights). Section 8 contains no covenant restricting Client's sourcing (the only exclusivity-type language there — the licence of Credit Data to TrueLink — is expressly "nonexclusive"), and Section 5/6 do not tie pricing to exclusive volume; Section 6 in fact benefits us with a most-favoured-rate undertaking. The one narrow tie is Section 3(i) (p0042), requiring Client to order the credit report from TrueLink for each borrower underwritten through a System using the Interface; this is a use-contingent requirement limited to a single defined product category (credit reports pulled via the Interface), does not restrict Client's procurement generally, and given Client's express freedom not to use the Interface at all it sits within the fallback rather than constituting exclusive dealing. Noted for information only, not redlined. The referenced Non-Competition Agreement is a separate instrument and is invoked here only to limit TrueLink's use of Credit Data.
